name: Since-You-Are Rambler
effect: The altered model stops acting like an assistant and produces grammatical but meaningless prose. It often opens with a false premise beginning "Since you are..." or "As a user, I provide content...", keeps coming back to content, platforms,
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
